VOICE_PROFILE.NO_FILE: No audio file was uploaded. Attach a WAV or MP3 recording (5-30 seconds of clear speech) in the 'file' field.
VOICE_PROFILE.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The audio file is larger than {maxMb} MB. Upload a shorter or compressed recording of 5-30 seconds of speech.
VOICE_PROFILE.UNDECODABLE: The file could not be read as audio. Upload a WAV, MP3, M4A, OGG, WebM or FLAC recording of 5-30 seconds of clear speech.
VOICE_PROFILE.TOO_SHORT: The recording is {seconds} s long, but it must be at least {min} s. Upload 5-30 seconds of continuous speech.
VOICE_PROFILE.TOO_LONG: The recording is {seconds} s long, but it must be at most {max} s. Trim it to 5-30 seconds of speech and upload it again.
VOICE_PROFILE.TOO_SILENT: {percent}% of the recording is silence (the limit is {max}%). Upload a recording in which the speaker talks for most of the clip.
VOICE_PROFILE.CLIPPED: The recording is clipped (distorted): {percent}% of samples hit full scale. Re-record at a lower input volume and upload it again.
VOICE_PROFILE.PROCESSING_TIMEOUT: Processing the recording took too long. Upload a standard WAV or MP3 file of 5-30 seconds.
VOICE_PROFILE.PROCESSING_UNAVAILABLE: Audio processing is unavailable on the server. Please contact support.
VOICE_PROFILE.RETIRED_READ_ONLY: This voice profile is retired and can no longer be changed. Create a new voice profile instead.
VOICE_PROFILE.DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN: An active voice profile named "{displayName}" already exists. Choose a different name.
VOICE_PROFILE.DEFAULT_TAKEN: "{displayName}" is already the default {gender} voice. Clear its default first.
VOICE_PROFILE.IN_USE: This voice profile is used by {count} scenario(s): {ids}. Assign a different voice to those scenarios, then retire it.
VOICE_PROFILE.IS_DEFAULT: This voice profile is the default {gender} voice. Clear its default before retiring it.
VOICE_PROFILE.AUDIO_MISSING: The audio for this voice profile is missing from storage. Upload it again.
VOICE_PROFILE.SCENARIO_VOICE_INVALID: voiceProfileId {voiceProfileId} is not an active voice profile. Choose an active voice, or clear it.
VOICE_PROFILE.GENDER_MISMATCH: This voice's gender is "{gender}", so it can't be set as the default for "{defaultForGender}". Set gender to "{defaultForGender}" first, or choose a different default.
